# MzansiChat

MzansiChat is a founder-led, done-for-you WhatsApp marketing service for owner-led businesses in Johannesburg, Pretoria and Gauteng, South Africa.

## Services
- Official Meta WhatsApp Business Platform setup through WhatChimp
- Consent-first customer journeys and opted-in subscriber lists
- Monthly branded posts, tracked WhatsApp entry points, approved subscriber campaigns and practical reporting
- Human handling of enquiries and final bookings by each client business

## Evidence
- Quick Cuts salon and barbershop: illustrative 12-post Style Edit example month; no unverified bookings or revenue claims.
